title: Pokemon TCG Espathra Scarlet & Violet - Paradox Rift 081/182 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This rare and highly sought-after Espathra card is a must-have for any serious Pokémon TCG collector. With its stunning holo finish and impressive Stage 2 evolution, this card is sure to be a valuable addition to your collection. The card features the powerful Deoxys and Espathra characters, and is made from high-quality card stock material.

This standard-sized card is perfect for display or for use in competitive play, and is suitable for ages 4 and up. The card is part of the Scarlet & Violet - Paradox Rift set, and is manufactured by Nintendo in English language. Don't miss out on your chance to own this rare holo card and add it to your collection today!
